title: Length of a zone of blocks
statement: Let $c$ be a configuration of a machine with $k$ work tapes, let $j\in\mathbb Z$, let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $b$ be either Boolean value. The zone formed from the blocks encoding coordinates $j$ through $j+n-1$, using read flag $b$, has length $nk$.
replaced:
A zone of $n$ consecutive blocks of a configuration of a $k$-work-tape machine has
length $n \cdot k$.
